start.description: First characters of the key, e.g. `bf_Ab12`.

expiresInDays.description: Omit for a key that does not expire.

permissions.description: What the key may do; must be a subset of the creator's own permissions.

key.description: The secret key. Shown once; store it now — it cannot be retrieved again.

start.description: First characters of the key, e.g. `bf_Ab12`.

available.description: False when the deployment disabled this feature.

enabled.description: Effective value: the workspace choice (or default) and the deployment switch.

workspaceValue.description: The workspace's own choice, or the default when it never chose.

Me.description: The signed-in user, their active workspace, role and permissions.

permissions.description: Permissions in the active workspace (empty without one).

MembersOverview.description: Members of the active workspace and its pending invitations.

link.description: Dashboard path to open, e.g. `/settings/members` (never another site).

titleKey.description: Message key the dashboard translates, e.g. `notifications.types.member_joined.title`.

updatedAt.description: Null until the settings are first saved.

role.description: The caller's role in this workspace.

PingJobsRequest.description: Enqueue system.ping jobs (smoke test for the queue pipeline).

count.description: How many ping jobs to enqueue.

idempotencyKey.description: Re-sending the same key enqueues nothing new.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. BL (Saint-Barthélemy), MF (Saint-Martin), FR.

ReplayEventAccepted.description: The delivery job that will run the subscriber again.

last4.description: Last four characters of the workspace value (long values only).

source.description: Where the value would come from: the workspace vault, the deployment env, or nowhere (null).

message.description: Short provider answer; never contains the secret.

SystemInfo.description: Build and runtime information about the API process.

TestNotificationAccepted.description: The domain event that will produce the notification.

memberId.description: Membership that becomes owner; the current owner becomes admin.

info.description: REST API (/v1). Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json; see docs/conventions/api.md.
